question: In a certain code language, ‘GIRL’ is coded as ‘QWNL’. What is the code for ‘KEPT’ in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘GIRL’ is coded as ‘QWNL’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/711c6ca40e11b8c36cc3d5fa230d3c52311e3ef687aa1d08d4f3e91a8ae3bdf3.png] 

Similarly, for 'KEPT'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eca986ce3d687bfbb25849fbad81007aaedd7718b41b0c7d271d56aa9815cf25.png] 

So, 'KEPT' will be written as 'YUJP'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
